 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Combine separated panels unless their colored cells overlap."""
    divider = next(i for i, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 5)
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    if any(left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0
           for r in range(len(left)) for c in range(len(left[r]))):
        return left
    return [
        [left[r][c] if left[r][c] != 0 else right[r][c]
         for c in range(len(left[r]))]
        for r in range(len(left))
    ]
"
}
